$schema: CI-00B Scientific Data Guard baseline (DS-001/ADR-0008). Repo-relative POSIX paths under databases/ or cache/ that pre-existing, non-CI-00B tests are already known to write when the full tests/ suite runs in one pytest session. Generated once from an observed CI run (2026-09-03, PR #109 commit f0fd5f1) via `SCIENTIFIC_DATA_GUARD_GENERATE=1 pytest -q tests/`. A path listed here is tolerated (printed, not failing); any OTHER path touched under databases/ or cache/ still fails the guard. Regenerating this file is a visible, reviewed diff -- never a silent side effect of a normal test run.
